card.title: Recognize Me
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you cut the ribbon, whose bridge is this?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And who stopped it leaning into the river?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did. We thanked the engineers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Could one engineer have a name?

mechanism: A pushes ceremonial collective thanks toward individual named credit for engineering the bridge.
confusable: Unlike asserting expertise to solve a task, A must elicit acknowledgment from B.
comparison: D09-a narrows town and engineers into one name; D09-b turns an impersonal buffet credit into a named announcement.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
